column1: # Words Malayalam speakers routinely write in Malayalam script but which are
# NOT phonetically derivable from the Malayalam phonetic rules: English
# spelling says little about English sound, so "school" would come out
# സ്ചൂൽ and "phone" ഫൊനെ. Typed on the Malayalam phonetic layout, the English
# spelling on the left resolves directly to the Malayalam form on the right,
# ahead of the rules and of the dictionary.
# A hand-written draft that wants a Malayalam speaker's review. A wrong entry
# here is worse than a missing one, since it outranks everything.
# Format: english<TAB>malayalam   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
# Keep the English key lowercase. First column is matched case-insensitively.
